title: Bavachinin exerts anti-tumor effects by activating TLR4/STING axis-dependent PANoptosis and synergistically enhances chemosensitivity in endometrial cancer.
authors: Shu, Wan; Chen, Guanxiao; Zhang, Jun; Dong, Kejun; Zhou, Ting; Cheng, Shuangshuang; Zhang, Tangansu; Zhang, Jiarui; Li, Haojia; Yao, Yuwei; Yu, Shuyang; Liu, Yan; Zhou, Xing; Shen, Xiaoyu; Wang, Hongbo
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药补骨脂酚通过TLR4/STING轴诱导子宫内膜癌细胞PANoptosis及增敏化疗，虽含分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: The incidence and mortality rates of endometrial cancer (EC), a malignancy originating from endometrium, have been increasing globally. Currently, there are no effective therapeutic options for patients with recurrent, chemoresistant, and metastatic forms of this disease. Through compound library screening, we identified that bavachinin (BVC) has a killing effect on EC cells. BVC is a bioactive small molecule with potential pharmacological effects derived from the traditional Chinese herb Proralea corylifolia L, but the specific mechanisms are unclear. We first discovered that BVC induces ZBP1 (Z-DNA binding protein 1)-mediated PANoptosis in EC cells, characterized by activating of pyroptosis, apoptosis, and necroptosis. BVC promoted reactive oxygen species (ROS) production, mitochondrial membrane potential (MMP, DeltaPsim) collapse, and ATM-CHK2 mediated DNA damage, which activated cGAS-STING pathway in EC cells. Mechanistically, network pharmacology, molecular docking, cellular thermal shift assays (CESTA), and drug affinity responsive target stability (DARTS) experiments revealed that BVC induced PANoptosis in EC cells by directly interacting with toll-like receptor 4 (TLR4), thereby triggering mitochondrial ROS generation, activating the cGAS-STING pathway. Notably, TLR4 knockdown inhibited STING-TBK1-IRF3 pathway and ZBP1-mediated PANoptosis. In addition, low-dose BVC combined with cisplatin increased phosphorylated H2AX expression, suggesting that BVC enhances the sensitivity of EC cells to cisplatin. In vivo studies demonstrated that BVC induced PANoptosis in EC, and BVC in combination with cisplatin had effective anti-tumor effect without injuring vital organs. These novel findings provide compelling evidence to support the clinical application of BVC and PANoptosis-based therapy for treating EC.
abstract_zh: 子宫内膜癌（endometrial cancer, EC）是一种起源于子宫内膜的恶性肿瘤，其发病率和死亡率在全球范围内持续上升。目前，对于复发、化疗耐药及转移性EC患者，尚无有效的治疗选择。通过化合物库筛选，我们发现补骨脂甲素（bavachinin, BVC）对EC细胞具有杀伤作用。BVC是一种源自传统中药补骨脂（Psoralea corylifolia L）的生物活性小分子，具有潜在药理效应，但其具体机制尚不明确。我们首次发现BVC在EC细胞中诱导ZBP1（Z-DNA结合蛋白1）介导的PANoptosis，其特征为焦亡、凋亡和坏死性凋亡的激活。BVC促进活性氧（reactive oxygen species, ROS）产生、线粒体膜电位（mitochondrial membrane potential, MMP, DeltaPsim）崩溃以及ATM-CHK2介导的DNA损伤，从而激活EC细胞中的cGAS-STING通路。在机制层面，网络药理学、分子对接、细胞热位移分析（cellular thermal shift assays, CESTA）和药物亲和响应靶标稳定性（drug affinity responsive target stability, DARTS）实验揭示，BVC通过直接与Toll样受体4（toll-like receptor 4, TLR4）相互作用，诱导EC细胞发生PANoptosis，进而触发线粒体ROS生成，激活cGAS-STING通路。值得注意的是，TLR4敲低抑制了STING-TBK1-IRF3通路及ZBP1介导的PANoptosis。此外，低剂量BVC联合顺铂可增加磷酸化H2AX的表达，表明BVC增强了EC细胞对顺铂的敏感性。体内研究表明，BVC在EC中诱导PANoptosis，且BVC与顺铂联合使用具有有效的抗肿瘤作用，且不损伤重要器官。这些新发现为BVC及基于PANoptosis的疗法在EC治疗中的临床应用提供了有力证据。
